title: The Keywords to Links Converter WordPress plugin before 2.2.5 does not validate a value submitted to one of its AJAX…
description: The Keywords to Links Converter WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.2.5 contain a vulnerability where an AJAX action does not properly validate input before saving it as an option. This option is later used in an arithmetic operation on every admin and front-end request, which can cause the entire site to return a fatal error. Users with the Subscriber role can exploit this flaw, potentially causing a denial of service until the option is manually reset.
